info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Cohorts API
info.description: Exposes cohort reports grouped by the period of a visitor's first visit. These endpoints transform archived first-visit cohort data into table and chart responses for the Cohorts plugin.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
(Required) Comma-separated cohort start dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
The maximum number of periods to include from each cohort start, or `false` to use the configured default.

request.description: Returns cohort metrics over time for the requested cohort start dates.

response.name:
Data tables keyed by time period containing the selected cohorts.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
The metric to return, or `null` to return all cohort metrics.
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
The maximum number of periods to include from each cohort start, or `false` to use the configured default.
Metric formatting mode to pass to the archive request, for example `all`.

request.description: Returns cohort data for the selected period and metric.

response.name:
Cohort rows keyed by first-visit period for the requested metric selection.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
